facts.raw_span: A 20-year-old woman was being monitored for a left ciliary body mass for 3 years presented with declining vision in her left eye
Her best-corrected visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses were unremarkable in both eyes
a nasal mass posterior to the lens was evident, which had grown considerably in size since her last visit
Ophthalmoscopic examination showed a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
Ultra-widefield imaging: White mass emanating anteriorly from the nasal ciliary body and protruding into the vitreous cavity
Vitreous aspirate cytology: Negative for malignant cells
Hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells with spindle nuclei
S100 (neural crest marker): Positive
Glial fibrillary acidic protein (astrocyte marker): Patchy positive
CD34 (fibroblast marker): Negative
Smooth muscle actin: Negative
A 20-year-old woman was being monitored for a left ciliary body mass for 3 years presented with declining vision in her left eye
Her best-corrected visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses were unremarkable in both eyes
a nasal mass posterior to the lens was evident, which had grown considerably in size since her last visit
Ophthalmoscopic examination showed a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
Ultra-widefield imaging: White mass emanating anteriorly from the nasal ciliary body and protruding into the vitreous cavity
Vitreous aspirate cytology: Negative for malignant cells
Hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells with spindle nuclei
S100 (neural crest marker): Positive
Glial fibrillary acidic protein (astrocyte marker): Patchy positive
CD34 (fibroblast marker): Negative
Smooth muscle actin: Negative

concepts.why: The presence of a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity, composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells with spindle nuclei, and positive S100 staining, are consistent with medulloepithelioma.

The ophthalmoscopic examination showing a large white mass and the histopathological findings of a hypovascular myxoid lesion with positive glial fibrillary acidic protein staining, suggest a neuroepithelial tumor.

The negative results for malignant cells, CD34, and smooth muscle actin, along with the presence of S100 and glial fibrillary acidic protein, are consistent with a diagnosis of neurofibroma, a type of benign nerve sheath tumor.

rationales.F06: The ultra-widefield imaging showing a white mass emanating from the nasal ciliary body is highly suggestive of a ciliary body tumor, which is more typical of medulloepithelioma and neuroepithelial tumor.
rationales.F08: The histopathological findings of a hypovascular myxoid lesion with spindle and stellate cells are more characteristic of neuroepithelial tumors and neurofibromas.
rationales.F09: The positive S100 staining suggests a neural crest origin, which is more typical of neuroepithelial tumors and neurofibromas.
rationales.F10: The patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein staining suggests a possible glial component, which is more typical of neuroepithelial tumors.
